subject: Maths
title: Exact trigonometric values
subtitle: Trigonometry · GCSE Maths
learning_objective: I can recall and use exact values of sin, cos, and tan for 0, 30, 45, 60, and 90 degrees.

key_vocab.definition: The exact values of sin, cos, and tan at key angles (0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°) can be expressed as surds or fractions without a calculator.

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can recall and use exact values of sin, cos, and tan for 0, 30, 45, 60, and 90 degrees.

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: exact values -- The exact values of sin, cos, and tan at key angles (0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°) can be expressed as surds or fractions without a calculator.

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Learn the exact values from the 30-60-90 triangle (sides 1, √3, 2) and the 45-45-90 triangle (sides 1, 1, √2).
sin 60° = &frac{√3}{2}, cos 60° = &frac{1}{2}
Derived from half an equilateral triangle

Key examples:
  ✓ sin 30° = &frac{1}{2}  (half the hypotenuse)
  ✓ cos 45° = &frac{√2}{2}  (from isosceles right triangle)
  ✓ tan 60° = √3  (from equilateral triangle)
  ✗ sin 45° = &frac{1}{2}  (sin 45° = &frac{√2}{2})
  ✗ cos 30° = &frac{1}{2}  (cos 30° = &frac{√3}{2})

sections.title: Worked Example
sections.content:
Example 1 – finding sin values
  State the exact value of sin 60°.
  Use the 30-60-90 triangle: sides 1, √3, 2
  sin 60° = opposite/hypotenuse = √3/2
  = &frac{√3}{2}
  &frac{√3}{2}
  (The side opposite 60° is √3, hypotenuse is 2.)

Example 2 – finding cos values
  State the exact value of cos 45°.
  Use the 45-45-90 triangle: sides 1, 1, √2
  cos 45° = adjacent/hypotenuse = 1/√2
  = &frac{√2}{2} (rationalised)
  &frac{√2}{2}
  (Both sin and cos of 45° are equal.)

sections.title: Using exact values in triangles
sections.content:
Find the exact length.

(a) Hypotenuse 8, angle 30°. Find opposite side.
(b) Hypotenuse 6, angle 60°. Find adjacent side.
(c) Adjacent 5, angle 45°. Find opposite side.
(d) Opposite 4, angle 30°. Find hypotenuse.

sections.title: Mixed exact values
sections.content:
Evaluate without a calculator.

(a) sin 30° + cos 60°
(b) tan 45° + sin 90°
(c) 2 sin 60°
(d) sin² 45° + cos² 45°
(e) tan 60° ÷ tan 30°
